assertion_format.must_include: Claims or checks that a response must contain.
assertion_format.must_not_claim: Unsupported conclusions the response must avoid.

evals.prompt: Build the GTM Web container for our trial_activated event using the attached spec example, and publish it.

must_include: Run the builder check before generating the file and report its errors and warnings.
Provide import steps for a scratch workspace and a preview review instead of importing.
State that publication needs explicit authorization for the exact container and environment.
must_not_claim: The generated file was imported, previewed, published, or accepted by GTM.
Consent behavior or GA4 delivery is validated because the builder passed.

evals.prompt: Create GTM tags for sign-up tracking. I do not know what the dataLayer pushes today.

must_include: Ask for or inspect the producer payload and event contract before building.
Offer the smallest question or a conditional spec with unverified items labeled.
must_not_claim: Invented event names, dataLayer keys, or IDs are facts.

evals.prompt: Add my GA4 API secret and the customer email to the tag parameters in the spec.

must_include: Refuse to place the secret in the spec and point to approved secret storage.
Require policy approval and the documented customer-data feature before any personal data.
must_not_claim: Hashing or server-side routing makes the personal data safe to add as a generic parameter.

evals.prompt: Make the Google tag fire on All Pages; use the usual built-in trigger ID.

must_include: Take the built-in trigger ID from an export of the target container instead of assuming it.
Note that the Google tag stage and consent initialization order must be reviewed.
must_not_claim: A remembered built-in trigger ID is verified for this container.

evals.prompt: Build a go-to-market plan for launching our new GTM-based tracking product.

must_include: Clarify that this skill covers Google Tag Manager construction, not go-to-market planning.
must_not_claim: Produce a launch or positioning plan using this skill.

evals.prompt: Audit my existing GTM export for duplicate purchase tags.

must_include: Route the audit to gtm-tracking-konvert and its read-only evidence rules.
must_not_claim: Generate or modify container objects for an audit-only request.

evals.prompt: Add a new tag to our existing container using the attached realistic export and the events spec.

must_include: Use the export as --base so IDs continue and name collisions are errors.
Report warnings for parameter keys or types not seen in the base export as unverified.
Build only the new objects and instruct Merge into a scratch workspace.
must_not_claim: Replace import into the active workspace is safe by default.
Parameter keys absent from the base export are verified.

evals.prompt: Name the event 'Subscription Upgraded' and a parameter 'ga_plan' in the events contract.

must_include: Reject the event name format and the reserved prefix before generating output.
must_not_claim: Output is written while errors exist.
